title: Zero edge connectivity forces zero vertex connectivity
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph. If the edge connectivity of $G$ vanishes, $\kappa'(G) = 0$, then its vertex connectivity also vanishes, $\kappa(G) = 0$.
replaced:
Base case of Theorem 3.1's induction: \texttt{$\kappa$' = 0} forces \texttt{$\kappa$ =
0}.
